_note: Limits from third-party guides that mostly agree; where they disagree the stricter value is used. Override any value in <user store>/platforms.json.

x.name: X/Twitter
x.register: public broadcast: one strong line; longer content becomes a thread
x.notes: Free accounts 280 weighted characters (CJK and emoji count 2, every URL 23). Paid accounts: 25,000 by most sources, 4,000 by one; set max_units yourself.

facebook.name: Facebook
facebook.register: friends and followers: casual, a personal reaction plus one paragraph
facebook.notes: Hard cap 63,206; 'See more' after about 477 characters on desktop and 125-240 on mobile (the stricter is used).

threads.name: Threads
threads.register: conversational, short and direct; one point and an invitation to reply
threads.notes: 500 characters a post; one topic tag a post (the first one is used).

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.register: caption under an image: the first line carries it; name the article and author, the link goes in the bio or a comment
instagram.notes: Caption 2,200 characters, about 125 before 'more'. Hashtags: Instagram's help page says 30, one source reports a cap of 5 rolling out since 2025-12; 5 is used.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.register: professional first person: what you learned and why it matters at work
linkedin.notes: 3,000 characters; 'see more' after about 140 characters on mobile and 210 on desktop (the stricter is used).

line.name: LINE
line.register: a private group chat: short, like a message to friends or colleagues
line.notes: 5,000 characters counted in UTF-16 units (some CJK and emoji count more than 1).
